## Change

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and any compatibility change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests use synthetic fixtures or loopback servers and do not contact a live HA.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests and release checks pass.
- [ ] UI sources and bundled assets are synchronized, when changed.
- [ ] Documentation/comments are in English and UI translation keys match.
- [ ] No credentials, private captures, household configuration or inventories are included.

State any live behavior that remains unverified. Use SECURITY.md for vulnerability reports.
